BiblicalUsage: Vaniah stands in the list of those who had taken strange wives, among the sons of Bani. The sons of Bani are listed family by family, and Vaniah's name is written among them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the list names him because repentance was personal: Vaniah is not a number but a man who had to put away what he had taken, and the Bible records the cost by name.
